algorithmProof.crestFft512: Thread t owns coord=t and coord2=t+256. For horizontal variants CHANNEL=x maps threadId.x/id.x; for vertical variants CHANNEL=y maps threadId.y/id.y. LoadInputs and StoreOutputs rewrite only the channel component, leaving row/cascade coordinates unchanged.
algorithmProof.barrierProof: Both coordinates are loaded before pass 0. Each pass begins with GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync, then every thread writes both coord outputs before any thread can pass the next barrier. Final barrier precedes output reads. No early return exists in ComputeFFT.
algorithmProof.thread255: threadId 255 processes indices 255 and 511; no index above 511 is generated for SIZE=512/ELEMENTS_PER_THREAD=2.
